headline: RTF action items for an Information Technology Administrator and a Library Page.
summary: Action items are two RTF requests, for an Information Technology Administrator and a Library Page. The agenda also lists public comment, correspondence, possible executive session, reports, and old and new business.
items: Executive session, if recommended by the town attorney
